externalReferenceCriteria.source: The Webby Awards 2025/2026 published judging criteria and immersive criteria

findings.observation: The continuation mechanism remains perceptible as a larger geometric enclosure around the authored region: the box has been expanded rather than perceptually dissolved.
findings.strategyObligation: World continuation must inherit the authored edge before progressively attenuating; no new navigable extent may be used to hide the seam.

findings.observation: Outer terrain, water, horizon and atmosphere do not yet form one continuous depth system. Tonal, elevation and frequency changes disclose the layer boundary.
findings.strategyObligation: Blend slope, shoreline direction, material frequency, haze and contrast continuously from local detail into distant representation.

findings.observation: The region reads predominantly arid or desert-like because exposed tan/brown material dominates while vegetation, moisture and humid atmospheric cues are insufficient for the intended subtropical coastal identity.
findings.strategyObligation: Establish subtropical identity through causal material, vegetation, moisture and atmospheric relationships rather than uniform greening.

findings.observation: Vegetation and surface material are not yet visibly governed strongly enough by drainage, freshwater proximity, shelter, slope, elevation, exposure and coastal influence.
findings.strategyObligation: Drive environmental distribution from reusable local causal fields.

findings.observation: The coast is geographically clearer after removing opposing land, but it remains biologically and materially sparse; beach, wet/dry transition, coastal vegetation and nearshore atmospheric relationships do not yet sell a warm living coast.
findings.strategyObligation: Treat shoreline as an ecological gradient, not merely a land-water boundary.

findings.observation: Gratitude remains too round and blob-like at macro scale. Local geometry is becoming more credible, but the overall disposition lacks enough directional asymmetry, headlands, bays, drainage orientation and relief logic to become a trustworthy continental positional standard.
findings.strategyObligation: Discover macro shape from proven regional geographic relationships rather than polishing the current outline.

findings.observation: Environmental work performed now can become regression debt if biome, hydrology or continuation logic is bound to the provisional silhouette.
findings.strategyObligation: Separate local environmental causality from final macro perimeter authority.

findings.observation: The experience has a distinctive spatial premise and meaningful direct traversal, but visible procedural boundaries, repetitive low-frequency terrain treatment, weak biome specificity and exposed continuation mechanics prevent the technology from becoming invisible and prevent the experience from reaching reference-class immersion and execution.
findings.strategyObligation: Use excellence review as a cross-cutting gate: the implementation mechanism must disappear perceptually while interaction remains legible and reliable.

findings.observation: H-Earth is now detailed enough to expose defects in the planetary representation, but not yet believable enough to become the source standard. Gratitude must first achieve credible local geography and environmental identity, then its proven positional relationships can drive Audralia morphology reconciliation.
findings.strategyObligation: Hold planetary morphology as provisional until the regional standard passes, then reconcile globe from proven regional evidence.

findings.observation: The installed excellence model requires phone, tablet and desktop first-glance readability plus interaction/navigation continuity. Current visual inspection evidence is insufficient to declare reference-class cross-device functionality, accessibility or performance complete.
findings.strategyObligation: Require exact-candidate phone/tablet/desktop initial, interaction and result-state qualification plus accessibility and performance checks before terminal pass.

findings.observation: For an immersive spatial surface, environmental content is the place itself. The current desert-like and procedurally bounded read communicates the wrong story about Gratitude before any explicit narrative can correct it.
findings.strategyObligation: Treat geographic, ecological, atmospheric and acoustic cues as primary content and require first-glance place identity.

findings.observation: The reciprocal globe-region model, noninteractive visible-world continuation and region-to-continent calibration concept are materially distinctive. Their value depends on being implemented as reusable causal systems rather than one-off visual patches.
findings.strategyObligation: Prefer reusable environmental and reciprocity rules whose success on Gratitude can become the standard for later regions.

interactionRisks.trigger: Attempting to fix A03 without A04
interactionRisks.result: Desert appearance is replaced by artificial decoration rather than subtropical ecology.

interactionRisks.trigger: Attempting to fix A01 by extending playable or uniformly rendered terrain again
interactionRisks.result: Boundary visibility moves outward instead of disappearing.

interactionRisks.trigger: Attempting to perfect A03/A04 around the current perimeter before A06/A07 are respected
interactionRisks.result: Environmental systems become dependent on a shape already known to be provisional.

interactionRisks.trigger: Forcing H-Earth to match current Audralia silhouette despite regional evidence
interactionRisks.result: Reciprocal development becomes one-way conformity and preserves the blob defect.

interactionRisks.trigger: Promoting the current regional candidate to planetary authority before it passes
interactionRisks.result: Temporary local defects propagate across Audralia.

interactionRisks.trigger: Treating reference-class review as surface polish only
interactionRisks.result: Innovation, functionality, immersion and overall experience remain below the benchmark despite prettier rendering.
